description:
Datavant Cloud enables privacy-preserving health data connectivity for federal government customers, stakeholders, and collaborators. Our privacy-preserving record linkage (PPRL) solution links person-level data across data silos using universal patient keys without exposing personally identifiable information (PII) or protected health information (PHI). Data governance controls are built-in to Datavant’s unique PPRL deployment model, providing assurance to data originators and data stewards that their data can only be processed by the right entity, for the right purpose, under the right conditions. 

Datavant features include:
- Governance controls that enable an array of data-sharing models including data collaboratives, registries, repositories, project-specific data-sharing, and single vs. bi-directional data linkages. 
- Trust frameworks that provide linkage honest broker, zero trust, and peer-to-peer models, providing data originators and data recipients with flexibility to connect data using their desired trust models.
- De-identified cohort discovery with Datavant’s extensive ecosystem of interoperable real world datapartners to discover shared cohorts and populations without needing to share underlying data.

Datavant services include:
- Datavant DeID+Link
- Datavant Match
- Datavant Desktop
- Datavant Web Portal features:
- Overlaps, Overlaps API
- Explore

Datavant solutions can be deployed on-premise, in virtualized environments, in cloud, and integrated locally within your native systems via our API.

description:
GCS is a FedRAMP Moderate (previously JAB P-ATO authorized) IaaS/PaaS/SaaS platform offering scalable compute, private cloud, and SaaS solutions to federal agencies. Customers may deploy on shared infrastructure, provision a dedicated private cloud, or co-locate their own hardware within the GCS authorization boundary.

Overview of Authorized Services

Compute (IaaS)
Configurable virtual machines balancing CPU, RAM, and high-I/O flash storage; available as pre-hardened images or custom builds.

Private FedRAMP Cloud (IaaS)
Dedicated, tenant-isolated compute, networking, and storage fully within the GCS boundary for agencies requiring resource segregation.

Bring Your Own Hardware
Customer-owned hardware co-located within the GCS boundary, leveraging inherited GCS controls for specialized appliances and equipment.

Virtual Desktop Services (DaaS)
Browser-accessible virtual desktops hosted within the GCS boundary, providing agency users with secure, managed access to applications and data from any endpoint without local installation requirements.

Authorization as a Service (AaaS)
Enables SaaS providers to inherit GCS controls and deliver FedRAMP-authorized products under the GCS P-ATO.

Calabrio Workforce Engagement Management (SaaS)
Contact center workforce optimization suite covering scheduling, agent performance analytics, and business intelligence.

Sharetru Federal (SaaS)
Managed File Transfer as a Service (MFTaaS) supporting CMMC, ITAR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS regulated data exchange.

Sayari Risk Intelligence (SaaS)
Supply chain and counterparty risk platform aggregating corporate ownership and trade data from 250+ jurisdictions.

GRID20/20 ATI (SaaS/IoT)
Cloud-based distribution grid and environmental monitoring platform covering wildfire detection, auto-alerting, and AI-enhanced analytics. Field sensor devices operate outside the authorization boundary and feed data into the GCS-hosted ATI application, which is fully within scope.

IGS Bridge (SaaS)
Secure, platform-agnostic integration suite connecting enterprise and legacy systems (Bridge Connect), coordinating clinical decision support (Bridge Care), standardizing data relationships (Bridge Map), and delivering real-time operational analytics (Bridge Monitor).

Automated Background Investigation System (ABIS)
ABIS is a personnel security case management system that tracks background investigations for Federal Employees, Contractors, Volunteers, and Interns from initiation through final adjudication. The system allows cases to be checked for transfer of trust, eApp initiation, and to conduct all pre-hire checks, and to make pre-hire and final adjudication determinations. The system also processes security clearances, SEAD-3 self-reporting, Detailee cases, and other types of cases. Interfaces with DCSA's eDelivery, CVS, OF79a Adjudications, and other interfaces are included in the system. The system fully implements Continuous Vetting (CV) and RapBack enrollment/unenrollment and processing of alerts received from CV/Rapback

NXXUS Unified Imaging Intelligence Platform
NXXUS is a federated enterprise imaging, clinical data, workflow, and AI orchestration platform. With NXXUS, healthcare organizations no longer need to replace their existing infrastructure or undertake a massive data migration; NXXUS creates a unified access and intelligence layer across those systems.

description:
Spectro Cloud Palette VerteX automates the provisioning of Kubernetes clusters across on-premise, Edge, and cloud systems allowing for easy development and deployment. Spectro Cloud has simplified the path to provisioning a functional Kubernetes cluster across multiple backend systems including but not limited to AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Azure. 

The system incorporates the provisioning of pre-hardened Amazon Machine Image (AMI) and container images as well as the ability to simplify deployments to pre-defined blueprints. Spectro Cloud delivers a simplified pipeline to customer management and deployment of Kubernetes at scale with the ability to support thousands of clusters. 

Palette VerteX allows users to construct flexible stacks from operating system (OS), Kubernetes, container network interfaces (CNI), and container storage interfaces (CSI) to additional add-on application services; therefore, the entire stack of Kubernetes is deployed, updated, and managed as one unit, without split responsibility from virtual machines, base OS, Kubernetes infrastructure, and add-ons.

functions_claimed.evidence: Spectro Cloud Palette VerteX automates the provisioning of Kubernetes clusters across on-premise, Edge, and cloud systems allowing for easy development and deployment.

description:
IICS for FedRAMP is a microservices-based, cloud-native data management solution which leverages industry-leading metadata capabilities to accelerate and automate core data management and data governance functions. IICS includes support for both Cloud Data Integration and Cloud Application Integration: 

Cloud Data Integration 

Built on a next-generation, microservices-driven software as a service (SaaS), Informatica Cloud Data Integration enables you to connect to industry-leading applications and data sources across on-premises and the cloud and allows you to integrate the data sources at scale. Optimize the performance of your development teams by employing a codeless UI; using drag-and-drop interfaces, and making complex integrations simple. 

Cloud Application Integration 

Informatica Cloud Application Integration (CAI) service offers a single, trusted solution to support any integration pattern, data set, user-type, or endpoint to automate business processes, expedite transactions, and enable real-time analytics. It is based on a modular, microservices-based architecture for agile support of future business requirements. CAI supports multiple new and unique integration patterns, which include on-premises to cloud real-time data integration, real-time/B2B application integration, process orchestration, data synchronization, and more. Users can integrate multi-cloud and hybrid applications without writing a single line of code. 

Each of the above services leverages Informatica's Secure Agent, which runs all your Cloud Data Integration and Cloud Application Integration workloads inside the customer’s infrastructure, ensuring the highest levels of security and performance.
